name: Files upload
description:
## Conversation Summary

1. **Request:** Add an "Upload files" action to the files-browser (`FileExplorer.vue`) right-click context menu, reusing the existing drag & drop upload pipeline (`handleFilesUpload` + `$api.files.upload`).
2. **First implementation:** Added the menu entry in `ContextMenu.vue` plus a hidden `<input type="file" multiple>` picker, resolving the destination "smartly" (blank area → current folder, selected folder → that folder, labelled "Upload here").
3. **Correction requested:** Uploads must always target the folder currently active in the explorer — no deriving the path from a selection, and no new folders created server-side.
4. **Revised implementation:** Removed `canUpload`/`uploadLabel` props and all selection-based target logic (`contextUploadTarget`, `uploadTargetPath`); the picker now always uploads to `getAbsolutePath(this.currentPath)`, computed at submit time.
5. **Result:** A single, always-visible "Upload files" menu item with predictable behaviour, shared progress/error handling, and untouched drag & drop flows — documented with a destination matrix, anti-patterns, and an accessibility checklist.

messages.content: File has to be uploaded to the current folder explorer active. Don't create new folders.

I'll verify the current implementation and how the upload API handles the target path.## 1. Review & Understand the Task - Uploads triggered from the files-browser context menu must land **in the folder currently open in the explorer** (`currentPath`), never in another folder. - No folder should be created as a side effect of an upload — so the target must always be the already-existing, absolute current directory path (`getAbsolutePath(this.currentPath)`). - Therefore the "smart" target resolution added previously (blank area → current dir, selected folder → that folder, `Upload here` label) must be removed: it could resolve to a sibling/relative path that the backend then creates. ## 2. Information Gathering | Fact | Source | |---|---| | Upload sends `path` to `/api/files/upload` and the server writes there | `src/api/modules/files.js` → `upload(file, path)` | | The current folder is `getAbsolutePath(this.currentPath)` and provably exists (it is the listing being displayed) | `FileExplorer.vue` → `loadDir()` | | Context menu props currently include `canUpload` / `uploadLabel` | `ContextMenu.vue` | | Drag & drop uploads (`onDrop`, `onDropEntry`) are a separate, explicit-destination flow | `FileExplorer.vue` → `handleFilesUpload()` | Root cause of "new folders": `contextUploadTarget` could return a path derived from a **selection** (possibly a relative `entry.file_path`, e.g. from search results). Sent to the backend, a non-resolving path makes the server create directories. ## 3. Change Proposal 1. **`ContextMenu.vue`** — drop `canUpload` / `uploadLabel` props, always render a single **Upload files** item that only emits `upload`. 2. **`FileExplorer.vue`** — remove `uploadTargetPath`, `contextUploadTarget`, `contextUploadLabel`; the picker handler always targets `getAbsolutePath(this.currentPath)`. Untouched: `handleFilesUpload()`, drag & drop handlers, all other menu actions. ## 4. Changes Summary | File | Change | |---|---| | `src/components/filebrowser/ContextMenu.vue` | Single fixed "Upload files" entry; `canUpload` / `uploadLabel` props removed | | `src/components/filebrowser/FileExplorer.vue` | Upload target is always the active folder; selection-based target logic and stored target removed | ## 5. The Changes ## 6. Behaviour After the Change | Action | Upload destination | |---|---| | Right-click empty area → **Upload files** | `getAbsolutePath(currentPath)` (the folder shown in the breadcrumb) | | Right-click a folder → **Upload files** | same — current folder, the folder is **not** navigated into or used as target | | Right-click a file → **Upload files** | same — current folder | | Drag & drop onto empty area | current folder (unchanged) | | Drag & drop onto a folder row | that existing folder (unchanged, explicit user gesture) | The context-menu path can no longer produce a relative/non-existent path, so the backend has nothing to create. ## 7. Anti-Patterns Avoided - ❌ Deriving the upload path from a **selection** (`entry.file_path`) — source of the phantom folders. - ❌ Storing the destination in component state across the async picker round-trip — now computed at submit time from `currentPath`, so a directory change while the picker is open cannot desync it. - ❌ Context-dependent labels ("Upload here") that imply a different destination than the actual one. ## 8. Accessibility Checklist - [x] Single, always-visible **Upload files** item — no conditional disappearance that would look like a broken menu. - [x] Text label + `title="Upload files to the current folder"` announce the destination. - [x] Native picker (hidden ``) keeps keyboard and screen-reader support. - [x] Menu closes before opening the picker, so focus return is predictable. ## 9. Implementation Steps 1. Open the files browser, navigate to the target folder. 2. Right-click anywhere (blank area, a file, or a subfolder) → **Upload files**. 3. Pick files → the progress banner shows and the **current** listing refreshes; no new directories are created.
